title: Hunt for Black Friday deals is steering toward record holiday spending
summary:
Shoppers are keeping especially busy this Black Friday, having already spent $7.1 billion online on Thanksgiving Day, according to Adobe Analytics.

The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley are joined by Washington Crossing Advisors senior portfolio manager Chad Morganlander to discuss the forecasts for continued consumer spending through Cyber Monday.

title: U.S. Black Friday online sales set to exceed $13 billion, Adobe predicts
summary: Investing.com -- U.S. online spending on Black Friday is expected to exceed $13 billion, according to Adobe Analytics, as shoppers pursue holiday discounts amid persistent inflation and elevated gasoline prices.
